reason: HealthEquity is an HSA custodian and consumer-directed benefits administrator (HSA, FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter). It sells to employers and plans and earns custodial, interchange and service fees. eHealth is an online insurance broker. It mainly sells Medicare plans to seniors and earns carrier commissions without taking underwriting risk. The two sell different products and earn money differently. Both touch healthcare benefits, but that link is only loose.
